title: Oda-chan to Akechi-kun
titleNative: 織田ちゃんと明智くん
synopsis: I should not be falling in love with this person... Enemy or lovers? The fiercest rivals in history return! Ryunosuke Akechi is the school's toughest delinquent, while Maria Oda is the beautiful idol of the school. Two people who live in different worlds, they start going out after Akechi confesses his feelings. However, when they kiss for the first time, memories of the fiery betrayal at Honnouji fill their heads...! A turbulent high school life begins, as their present-day love affair becomes intertwined with grudges from the past! (Source: Morning, translated)

title: Tokimeki Tonight
synopsis: This is a long, epic manga that spans three generations of the Etou family. The first part is about Ranze, a relatively normal high school girl, except for the fact that her father is a vampire, her mother is a werewolf, and that she has magical powers of her own. Her family was banished from the Magic World to live among the humans, and they now guard the gate between the two realms. The story really begin when Ranze falls for a human boy, which her parents strictly forbid. Later story arcs focus on Ranze's brother and on Ranze's daughter. (Source: Anime News Network) Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

title: Youheidan no Ryouriban
synopsis: The story begins when Azuma Akari, a young man with an ambition to be a chef, trips into another world. Akari is picked up by Gangreve, the leader of a mercenary group. Akari joins the group as an odd job and gradually increases hia own value by demonstrating hia cooking skills. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking. By improving the mercenary group's food situation and occasionally helping with inventions, Akari is gradually recognized by his fellow members of the mercenary group. However, Akari does not yet know that he himself will become a hero.
